Devon Singh: Quick heads up — onsite loop scheduled for candidate Rowan Park (SWE Sr) on Tue Apr 7, arrival 9:15am PT. Need confirmations: panel + lab machine + badge pickup. :calendar:

Maya Chen: Done — fallback meeting link: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/734211903 (passcode: Redwood123). Agenda sent to candidate and panel.

Priya N: Yep 11:15–12 PT works. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: Sending calendar invites now, will include the loaner serial and the security ticket number in the invite.
Cheng Liu: If coding exercise needs more than 60 min we can extend by 15; add a 15-min buffer after each session.
Maya Chen: Noted — adding 15-min buffer blocks. Remote test machine available at `ssh rowan@lab.redwood.ai` (pw provided to candidate after arrival by IT).
Alex Kim: Thanks all. One last ask — can someone confirm parking pass? Rowan will drive in.
Facilities: Parking pass reserved — zone B, pass code: PARK-77. We'll email directions.
Devon Singh: Great. If anything changes ping here. :wave:
